description: This file defines a telemetry tracking class for autocomplete suggestions, including functions for generating suggestion keys, managing visibility tracking, and capturing various telemetry events related to autocomplete interactions in an editor environment.

classes.name: AutocompleteTelemetry
classes.description: A class for tracking and sending telemetry events related to autocomplete suggestions, including visibility tracking and event capturing for suggestion requests, filtering, cache hits, and user acceptance.

methods.name: getSuggestionKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a suggestion based on its prefix, suffix, and text.

methods.name: captureEvent
methods.description: Internal method to send telemetry events via TelemetryService.

methods.name: captureSuggestionRequested
methods.description: Logs an event when a suggestion is requested by the autocomplete provider.

methods.name: captureSuggestionFiltered
methods.description: Logs an event when a suggestion is filtered out, with reasons.

methods.name: captureCacheHit
methods.description: Logs an event when a suggestion is retrieved from cache.

methods.name: captureLlmSuggestionReturned
methods.description: Logs an event when a new suggestion is returned from the language model.

methods.name: captureLlmRequestCompleted
methods.description: Logs a successful language model request with metrics.

methods.name: captureLlmRequestFailed
methods.description: Logs a failed language model request with error details.

methods.name: captureAcceptSuggestion
methods.description: Logs when a suggestion is accepted by the user.

methods.name: startVisibilityTracking
methods.description: Begins tracking the visibility duration of a suggestion for telemetry.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and pending timers.
